text:
emma.docs: FYI customer on an air-gapped RHEL8 minimal image hit an installer problem: installer can't run restorecon because policycoreutils isn't installed. I opened a docs PR with two paths: RPMs should ship an SELinux filecontexts (\.fc) file or the installer should fall back to chcon + a postinstall note. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4810

raj.sre: can you paste the short failure log?

emma.docs: minimal log: 'restorecon: SELinux:  Could not locate policy file' — installer tried to run /sbin/restorecon during preflight and it failed on minimal installs.

leo.packaging: packaging note: if we include a .fc in the RPM and run 'rpm --restorecon' post-install, that avoids needing semanage/restorecon at install time. Another option: include a tiny post-install script that calls 'chcon -t var_run_t' as fallback and document that semanage is preferred for permanence.

ops-bot: CI lint: PR 4810 check failing — internal KB link 'https://kb.redwood.internal/selinux-packaging' 404.

emma.docs: fixed PR to remove placeholder and added an Advanced > SELinux Packaging section with .fc sample and an example systemd unit fragment pointing sockets to /run/redwood/hsm. Also added a short migration script for existing installs that only uses mv/chown/chcon so it works air-gapped.

raj.sre: wording suggestion for Troubleshooting FAQ: 'If your installer runs on a minimal, air-gapped image, prefer packaging the filecontext with the RPM. If that is not possible, run the chcon workaround and plan to reapply the semanage/fcontext after a relabel.' Keep semanage example in Advanced only.

leo.packaging: added a small unit test in the packaging repo that starts the service in a container with PrivateTmp and verifies the socket lands in /run/redwood/hsm and file context is correct. I'll link the test in the PR.
